info.title: Distru Public API - Products
info.description: Reconciled with live wire shapes 2026-05-25. See categories/products.md for full field grids, read/write field-name inversions, and the list of formerly-documented fields that are NOT in the wire (compliance_type, metrc_item_name, metrc_item_category, upc, tags, is_inactive, is_archived, primary_test_result, internal_notes, inserted_datetime, image_urls).

get.description: List products. Page size 5,000. Eventually consistent ~1s. NO /brands /categories /subcategories /product-lines endpoints exist — reference data discoverable only via embedded refs on Product responses.

parameters.name: deleted
parameters.description: Tri-state. `include` returns soft-deleted rows with deleted_at populated.

parameters.name: menu_id
parameters.description: COMMA-STRING multi-value (NOT bracket array) — odd one out: ?menu_id=uuid1,uuid2

200.description: Paginated products (~26 wire keys per record — see categories/products.md). NO upc, NO tags, NO compliance_type, NO metrc_item_name/category, NO primary_test_result (those are doc-only, never emitted).

post.description: UPSERT. READ/WRITE FIELD INVERSIONS: read vendor/product_group/brand as full embeds; write vendor_id/group_id/brand_id. is_active inverts to is_inactive on write.

200.description: Same shape as list — 26 wire keys

get.description: List test results. HYPHEN slug (NOT /test_results — that returns 404). Page size 5,000. Eventually consistent ~1s. Decision #5 REVERSED in Phase 0.5 — test results ARE importable.

200.description: Paginated test results. additional_test_results is an OPEN MAP — store as JSON.

Test result — wire keys: id, name, lab_name, lab_license_number (NOT license_number), release_date (NOT result_datetime), package_id, batch_id, is_primary, mg_per_unit_type, granular thc_/cbd_ percentage+mg fields, additional_test_results open map, updated_datetime. NO metrc_lab_test_id, product_id, sample_id, expiration_datetime, passed_test, test_status, moisture_content, water_activity, inserted_datetime, potency_thc/cbd — all skill-doc fiction.

get.description: List POS mappings. HYPHEN slug. id is INTEGER (not UUID). inserted_at/updated_at use _at suffix (not _datetime — opposite of every other entity).

delete.description: The ONLY DELETE endpoint in the entire Distru public API.

post.description: HYPHEN slug, POST-ONLY (no GET). Returns INTEGER id. Read custom field definitions only via custom_data[] on entity responses.
